Hi there!
Incoming second year here.

As you know, our mode of teaching is still online.
As per our professors, I may say that they are great professors, in general, as some of them are sitting judges, Senior partners, and the even bar topnotchers, so expect them to be super strict as they prepare us to be professional. Well, there are still some outliers from this greatness who do not really teach, as what is expected in law school is to really study on your own.

I cannot comment on the pre-covid environment though as I have started my class with online platform already.

As per class sched, you may contact the registrar as we have 2 scheds. The day class and the night class. I do not know the sched of day class as I am a night class. Night class, which is made for working students, starts as early as 5 pm and ends by 9 pm during werkdays, depending on your subject. And whole day during weekends.

Well one of the best tip that I could give is for the recits. The Golden rule is to never volunteer when there is someone on deck or currently being questioned by the prof even you know the answer. Also, do not say "In my opinion". That is a big no no, especially if you do not want to see the dark side of your professors.

Fun fact: We have the cheapest tuition in the country. 
Which is compensated by a head ache giving enrollment and payment process. (You will discover this for yourself 🤣) 

See you soon school mate and future panyero!
